rule: Objects are 8-connected single-colour components on a 0 background. An object is erased (set to 0) when every one of its cells lies inside the inclusive bounding box of a strictly larger object of a different colour. All other objects are kept.
scope: Erase whole 8-connected monochromatic objects whose cells lie inside the inclusive bounding box of a strictly larger different-colour object. Native scenes construct 1..3 containers (optional 1..6), with rectangular or diagonally cut outlines, gaps, optional inward thickness, contained objects and outside or straddling distractors. Default grids span 7..30; explicit native controls support 4..30, and explicit latent scenes reconstruct smaller canonical cases. Loose-object sampling now targets 0..10 rather than 0..5, with an exact optional num_loose control 0..12.

Native erased objects use polygon interiors or gap cells, not cut-corner regions outside the outline. A bbox-contained cut-corner example is checked as an explicit extension of the archived solver hypothesis.

Default loose count is best-effort on tight grids. Explicit num_loose requires the exact count or raises after bounded placement; failure is not proof that no layout exists. Container packing uses a randomized lattice fallback.

authored_scope: Random mode draws 1..3 containers by default, and up to 6 on request, on grids of 7..22 per side by default; sizes 4..30 are accepted as synthetic extensions. Containers are rectangles, symmetric or asymmetric octagons and diamonds. They may have an inward-thickened run on one side and may be opened by a gap in a side. Inner objects of other colours (1..3 per container) are placed in the interior or in gap cells, including gap cells on the bbox border. The first container always has at least one. Loose distractors (0..5) are either far away or near-misses that cross a container bbox without lying wholly inside any container bbox. Explicit (containers, inners, loose) latent lists reproduce the fixtures exactly. Not supported: nested or touching containers; erased objects in cut-corner regions outside the outline; cases where the 'strictly larger' or 'different colour' clause alone decides the outcome; backgrounds other than 0.
authored_constraints: Every object is a single 8-connected component, and same-colour objects never touch (8-adjacency), so components never merge.
Container boxes are separated by at least one blank row or column.
Every container keeps at least one blank interior cell, so 0 is always present and is the background.
Gaps never remove bbox-defining endpoints, so the outline's bbox equals its placed box.
Every inner object is contained in the bbox of a larger, different-colour container.
No container or loose object is contained by the rule, and no loose object lies wholly inside any container box regardless of colour.
Width, height, num_containers, colours and coordinates must be non-bool integers; malformed inputs raise ValueError.
All retry loops are bounded, and the lattice fallback guarantees container placement when capacity allows.
